description: Start asynchronous contact enrichment for businesses the user already has. This uses Pay on Find. First call check_account, state the maximum cost (up to 3 credits per submitted business, capped by the available balance), and obtain confirmation. Starting the job requires at least 1 credit per business during a trial or 1.5 credits per business on a paid plan. Use one stable idempotency_key for retries.
